name: System of a Down

whyMatters.en: Los Angeles Armenian-American four-piece formed in 1994. Toxicity (2001) put odd meters, political shouting, and abrupt dynamic cuts on nu-metal radio without hip-hop beds.
whyMatters.zh: 洛杉矶亚美裔四人组，1994 年成立。Toxicity（2001）把奇数拍、政治喊叫与突然动态切换送上 nu-metal 电台，且无 hip-hop 铺底。

lyricQuotes: I cry when angels deserve to die
More, give me more / Give me more

shortBio.en: Tankian / Malakian alt-metal; Chop Suey! (2001) is the main structural reference for mid-song tempo and intensity changes.
shortBio.zh: Tankian / Malakian 的 alt-metal；Chop Suey!（2001）是曲中速度与强度切换的主要结构参照。

body.en:
Formed in 1994 in Los Angeles. The self-titled debut and Toxicity combine Tankian’s theatrical vocal, Malakian’s riff cuts, odd-time drums, and Middle Eastern melodic ornaments.

Chop Suey! (2001) changes tempo and intensity mid-song without a conventional bridge. The band shared early-2000s charts with Linkin Park while using less hip-hop and more abrupt, prog-like section changes.
body.zh:
1994 年于洛杉矶组建。同名首专与 Toxicity 结合 Tankian 的戏剧人声、Malakian 的 riff 切割、奇数拍鼓与中东旋律装饰。

Chop Suey!（2001）在曲中切换速度与强度，不依赖常规桥段。乐队与 Linkin Park 共享 2000 年代初榜单，更少 hip-hop、更多突然的、近 prog 的段落切换。

note.en: Tempo flip mid-song; dual vocal without rap verse.
note.zh: 曲中速度翻转；双人声但无 rap 主歌。

note.en: Odd-meter main riff; title track on rock radio.
note.zh: 奇数拍主 riff；标题曲上摇滚电台。

note.en: Mezmerize lead single; dance-punk jump and political chant.
note.zh: Mezmerize 主打；dance-punk 跳感与政治 chant。

body.en:
Toxicity (2001) put SOAD on MTV and rock radio beside Linkin Park. Chop Suey! flips tempo and vocal register halfway; Aerials slows into a melodic chorus with Middle Eastern scale color.

Malakian’s staccato riffs and Tankian’s operatic shout define the four-piece—no DJ chair.
body.zh:
Toxicity（2001）把 SOAD 送上 MTV 与摇滚电台，与 Linkin Park 并列。Chop Suey! 半途翻转速度与声区；Aerials 慢下来进旋律副歌，带中东音阶色彩。

Malakian 断奏 riff 与 Tankian 歌剧式喊叫定义四人组——无 DJ 席。

body.en:
Tankian, Malakian, Odadjian, and Dolmayan are the only lineup on all five studio albums. Malakian shares vocal duty on later records; Tankian remains the primary face.

Hiatus gaps (2006–10, 2017–) separate touring from recording; catalog peak is the 2001–05 four-piece.
body.zh:
Tankian、Malakian、Odadjian、Dolmayan 是五张录音室专辑的唯一阵容。Malakian 后期分担人声；Tankian 仍是主面孔。

停摆空档（2006–10、2017–）切开巡演与录音；目录峰值是 2001–05 四人组。

title.zh: Nu-metal 榜单里的 prog 突然性

body.en:
Slayer and Metallica sit in the thrash weight; Black Sabbath in the down-tuned chug. Tool shared festival bills; Linkin Park shared radio with more linear hooks.

Later alt-metal often copied tempo flips more than Armenian lyrical themes.
body.zh:
Slayer 与 Metallica 在 thrash 重量里；Black Sabbath 在降调 chug 里。Tool 共享音乐节账单；Linkin Park 共享电台，钩子更线性。

后来的 alt-metal 多抄速度翻转，少抄亚美尼亚歌词主题。

body.en: Tempo flip mid-song; dual vocal without rap verse.
body.zh: 曲中速度翻转；双人声但无 rap 主歌。

body.en: Odd-meter main riff; title track on rock radio.
body.zh: 奇数拍主 riff；标题曲上摇滚电台。

body.en: Mezmerize lead single; dance-punk jump and political chant.
body.zh: Mezmerize 主打；dance-punk 跳感与政治 chant。

interviewQuotes.text: Odd time and odd politics belong in the same verse.
interviewQuotes.speaker: Serj Tankian

interviewQuotes.text: We jump styles inside a song because boredom is the enemy.
interviewQuotes.speaker: Daron Malakian

note.en: Armenian-American alt-metal; stop-start riffs and dual vocal.
note.zh: 亚美尼亚裔美式 alt-metal；断续 riff 与双人声。

note.en: Tempo flip and screamed bridge as Toxicity’s main radio single.
note.zh: 速度翻转与嘶吼桥段，作 Toxicity 主要电台单曲。

note.en: Nu-adjacent metal with folk ornaments and odd meters; politics in plain speech.
note.zh: 邻 nu-metal 的金属，带民谣装饰与奇数拍；政治用直白说话。
